stemMd: A student says that because runoff volume fell, sediment concentration must have fallen by exactly the same percentage. Which response is supported by the definition and data?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Both concentrations are equal because the same soil was used.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Concentration cannot be computed when runoff is nonzero.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Concentration depends on both mass and volume, so its percentage change need not equal the volume change

explanationMd: Bare concentration is2.1/70=0.03g/mL and covered concentration0.5/50=0.01g/mL. Concentration falls by two-thirds while volume falls by20/70, about29%; the changes differ.

distractorRationale.a: The bare value0.03g/mL differs from the covered value0.01g/mL.
distractorRationale.d: The definition requires mass divided by volume.
